setting: Bir kasaba festivalinin programini ve saha yerlesimini anlatan tanitim konusmasi
context_line: You will hear the co-ordinator of a riverside festival explaining this year's programme and the layout of the site.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: Good evening, and thank you for coming along. I co-ordinate the Netherby Riverside Festival, and as this is the first year we've run it across a whole weekend rather than a single afternoon, I thought I'd take you through what has changed and, more usefully, where everything is going to be.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: So, dates first. We're on the second and third of September. Gates open at half past ten on the Saturday. I know the leaflet says eleven, but we brought it forward once the bus timetable was published, so please ignore the leaflet on that one. On the Sunday we start an hour later, at half past eleven, which gives the stewards a lie-in.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: Tickets. A weekend ticket is eighteen pounds. It was fifteen last year and I'm sorry about the increase, but the cost of hiring the meadow has gone up. A single day is eleven pounds, and anyone under sixteen comes in free, provided they're with an adult. If you book online you'll be sent a code, and you exchange the code for a wristband at the gate. Do look after it — we can't replace a lost wristband, and the same one won't get two people in.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: Now, the site, because it's laid out quite differently this year. You come in through the main gate, which is off Bridge Road at the southern end of the meadow. As you walk through, the box office is immediately on your left; that's where the codes are swapped for wristbands. Opposite the box office, on your right, is the information point, and the lost property cabin sits next to it.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: Straight ahead of you, at the far end of the meadow, is the main stage. It faced the river last year, which meant the sound travelled straight across to the houses on the other bank, and we heard about it. This year it faces back towards the gate.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: Between the information point and the main stage, on the right-hand side, you'll find the craft marquee. Beyond the marquee, running along the hedge, are the food stalls, and the toilets are behind them, with a free water point beside the toilets. Fill your bottle there rather than buying one.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: On the left-hand side, next to the box office, is the workshop tent. Past the workshop tent, at the western end of the meadow, is the family field, and that's where the storytelling and the puppet shows happen. The riverside path runs behind the main stage and stays open all weekend — it's a public right of way, so nothing may be parked or stacked on it. And the cycle racks are outside the gate, on the left of the entrance path.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: Which brings me to getting there. There is no parking on the meadow at all. The park-and-ride operates from the leisure centre car park, and the shuttle bus runs every fifteen minutes. The poster said every twenty, but we've managed to hire a second bus. Parking at the leisure centre costs four pounds for the day, and the last bus back leaves at twenty past eleven.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: The programme itself. On Saturday the main stage opens with the community choir at midday, and the headline act comes on at eight. Sunday finishes earlier — the final set is at six, and that's a condition of our licence, so there's no chance of stretching it.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: The workshops used to be Saturday only; from this year they run on both days. They're free, but you do have to put your name down at the information point on the morning itself, because each session takes twelve people and they fill up fast. The one to book early is willow weaving — last year we turned more people away from that single workshop than from all the others put together.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: A few practical points. The food stalls take cards as well as cash, which they didn't last year. What you can't bring onto the site is glass of any kind; that's the one condition our licence is strict about, and the stewards will ask you to leave bottles at the gate. Dogs are welcome on a lead, though not in the family field, where the younger children are.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: If the weather turns, head for the craft marquee — it holds three hundred, and we'd rather have you dry than damp. And if you would like to be involved, we're still short of stewards for the Sunday afternoon. Volunteers get a weekend wristband and a meal voucher, and the shift is four hours.

turns.speaker: M1
turns.text: Finally, the full programme is on our website now, and printed copies will be at the information point from the tenth of August. If you'd rather ask a person, the festival office is open on weekday mornings. Thank you, and I hope to see a good many of you on the meadow.

notes: turn_index degerleri 0 tabanlidir. Bes celdirici duzeltme var: acilis saati (brosurdeki on bir -> on bucuk), hafta sonu bileti (on bes -> on sekiz), sahnenin yonu (nehre bakiyordu -> kapiya bakiyor), servis sikligi (afisteki yirmi dakika -> on bes dakika), atolye gunleri (yalniz Cumartesi -> iki gun de). Saha plani on uc ogeli; tarif 3-6. repliklerde. Metinde rakam yok.
